Container.Name: Feldorns-Free-Games-Claimer
Container.Overview:
Feldorn's fork of vogler/free-games-claimer. It claims free games automatically from Epic Games, Amazon Prime Gaming/Luna, GOG and Steam, and adds a web control panel, a built-in scheduler, Microsoft Rewards, FAB assets and notify-only watchers.
**What the fork adds**
- Control panel on port 7080: sessions, embedded browser (noVNC), stats, schedule, logs, alerts, notifications and settings - Built-in scheduler (no cron needed) with pause, jitter and claim history - Captcha pause with a push notification that deep-links to the embedded browser - Cookie upload for logins blocked by fingerprinting - Microsoft Rewards (daily desktop and mobile Bing searches and activity cards) - Optional FAB asset claiming, a Steam quality filter, Prime to Steam key auto-redeem - Notify-only watchers for Ubisoft, Humble, Fanatical, Lenovo, IndieGala, PlayStation Plus and Xbox - Home Assistant sensors at /api/hass/sensors and Apprise notifications
**First run**
1. Start the container and open the WebUI (port 7080). Nothing is claimed on boot. Unraid passes your server's timezone (TZ), which the scheduler and browser use. 2. Sessions tab: click **Login** for each store, sign in inside the embedded browser (captcha, 2FA, Steam Guard) and click **I'm Logged In**. Then **Check All Sessions**. 3. Set a schedule: Daily Start Time below, or Settings > Scheduler in the panel. With no schedule, nothing runs automatically. 4. Optional: add Apprise notification URLs and PUBLIC_URL so captcha alerts link back to the panel.
Store credentials and OTP keys are optional. They only enable automatic re-login when a session expires. Settings saved in the panel override these variables. Disable stores you do not use with the Active switches or in Settings.
**Security:** the panel has no password by default, and port 6080 gives full control of a browser logged in to your accounts. Keep it on your LAN or set Settings > Web UI Auth (or PANEL_PASSWORD); with auth on, noVNC runs through the panel and you can remove port 6080.
Raw VNC: add a port mapping for 5900 and set VNC_PASSWORD if you want to use a VNC client.
Multiple accounts: run one container per account, each with its own appdata folder and port pair. Full variable reference: https://github.com/feldorn/free-games-claimer/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md

Config.Name: WebUI / Control Panel
Config.Description: Control panel (sessions, embedded browser, stats, schedule, settings). If you change it, also set PANEL_PORT to the same value; the image health check uses 7080.

Config.Name: noVNC
Config.Description: Embedded browser (noVNC) used for logins and captchas. Host and container port must be identical (change NOVNC_PORT and both sides together). Not needed once panel auth is on, because noVNC is then proxied through the panel. Not password-protected on its own.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Browser sessions, claim databases, config.json (Settings tab), config.env, screenshots and logs.

Config.Name: Panel Password
Config.Description: Optional password for the control panel. The preferred way is Settings > Web UI Auth. With auth on, noVNC goes through the panel and port 6080 can be removed.

Config.Name: Daily Start Time
Config.Description: HH:MM daily run time in TZ, e.g. 08:00. With no schedule set, nothing runs automatically (use Run Now or the Schedule tab).

Config.Name: Start Jitter (minutes)
Config.Description: Random delay 0-720 minutes added to START_TIME.

Config.Name: Start Days
Config.Description: Days to run with START_TIME. 0=Sunday.

Config.Name: Loop (seconds)
Config.Description: With START_TIME: sub-daily cadence. Alone: interval after each run finishes. 0 = off.

Config.Name: Run On Startup
Config.Description: 0 off, 1 run once at container start, 2 run once then exit (set Restart Policy to no, otherwise it loops).

Config.Name: Notification URLs (Apprise)
Config.Description: Apprise URL(s), space separated, e.g. discord://webhook_id/token, tgram://bottoken/ChatID, ntfys://topic, pover://user@token. https://github.com/caronc/apprise/wiki

Config.Name: Notification Title
Config.Description: Optional notification title.

Config.Name: Notification Level
Config.Description: all, actions (only things that need you), digest (one daily summary) or off.

Config.Name: Digest Hour
Config.Description: Hour 0-23 for the daily digest.

Config.Name: Attach Screenshots
Config.Description: Attach screenshots to notifications.

Config.Name: Captcha Notify Priority
Config.Description: Priority of captcha alerts.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: External panel URL used for deep links in notifications, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7080 or https://fgc.example.com. Without it, captcha links point to localhost.

Config.Name: Default Email
Config.Description: Fallback login email for every store. Optional: you can log in through the panel instead.

Config.Name: Default Password
Config.Description: Fallback password for every store.

Config.Name: Epic Games Email
Config.Description: Overrides EMAIL for Epic Games.

Config.Name: Epic Games Password
Config.Description: Overrides PASSWORD for Epic Games.

Config.Name: Epic Games OTP Key
Config.Description: TOTP secret for automatic 2FA (Epic > Password & Security > third-party authenticator > Manual Entry Key).

Config.Name: Epic Games Parental PIN
Config.Description: Parental control PIN, if set.

Config.Name: Epic Games Active
Config.Description: Claim Epic Games Store freebies.

Config.Name: Epic Games Mobile
Config.Description: Also claim Epic mobile games.

Config.Name: Epic Games Notify Only
Config.Description: Only notify about free games, never click Get (for captcha-prone IPs).

Config.Name: Epic Captcha Wait (minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes to wait for you to solve a captcha.

Config.Name: Prime Gaming Email
Config.Description: Amazon account for Prime Gaming / Luna.

Config.Name: Prime Gaming OTP Key
Config.Description: Amazon TOTP secret (Login & security > 2-step verification > Add new app > Can't scan).

Config.Name: Prime Gaming Active
Config.Description: Claim Prime Gaming / Luna games.

Config.Name: Prime Gaming Redeem
Config.Description: Redeem keys on external stores (experimental).

Config.Name: Prime Steam Auto-Redeem
Config.Description: Queue Steam keys from Prime for the next Steam run.

Config.Name: Prime Retry Pending
Config.Description: Retry pending Microsoft Store / Xbox codes.

Config.Name: Prime Time Left (days)
Config.Description: Skip games with more than this many days left.

Config.Name: Prime Base URL
Config.Description: Country-specific Luna domain.

Config.Name: Legacy Games Email
Config.Description: Email for Legacy Games redemptions (defaults to PG_EMAIL).

Config.Name: GOG 2FA Backup Codes
Config.Description: Comma-separated GOG backup codes, used one at a time (GOG uses email codes, no TOTP).

Config.Name: GOG Active
Config.Description: Claim GOG giveaways.

Config.Name: GOG Keep Newsletter
Config.Description: 1 keeps the newsletter subscription GOG adds when claiming.

Config.Name: Steam Email
Config.Description: Steam account. Steam Guard codes are entered through the embedded browser.

Config.Name: Steam Active
Config.Description: Claim free-to-keep Steam promos.

Config.Name: Steam Min Rating
Config.Description: 1-9 (6 = Mostly Positive).

Config.Name: Steam Min Price (USD)
Config.Description: Minimum original price.

Config.Name: Steam Skip Unrated
Config.Description: Skip games without reviews.

Config.Name: Steam Points Shop Weekly
Config.Description: Claim the weekly free Points Shop item.

Config.Name: Microsoft Email
Config.Description: Microsoft Rewards account.

Config.Name: Microsoft OTP Key
Config.Description: Only for TOTP-app 2FA.

Config.Name: Microsoft Rewards Active
Config.Description: Desktop Bing searches and activity cards.

Config.Name: Microsoft Rewards Mobile Active
Config.Description: Mobile Bing searches.

Config.Name: Microsoft Schedule Window (hours)
Config.Description: Daily window width for Microsoft Rewards. 0 = not scheduled on its own.

Config.Name: Microsoft Schedule Start Hour
Config.Description: Window start hour 0-23.

Config.Name: Microsoft Run With Main Chain
Config.Description: Run Microsoft Rewards right after the claimers.

Config.Name: Microsoft Max Search Delay (s)
Config.Description: Upper bound of the random pause between searches.

Config.Name: Microsoft Redeem Threshold
Config.Description: Points balance that triggers a redeem reminder.

Config.Name: FAB Assets Active
Config.Description: Claim free FAB (Unreal) assets with the Epic session.

Config.Name: Ubisoft Watcher
Config.Description: Notify-only watcher.

Config.Description: Notify-only watcher.

Config.Description: Notify-only watcher.

Config.Description: Notify-only watcher.

Config.Name: PlayStation Plus Watcher
Config.Description: Notify-only watcher.

Config.Name: Xbox / Game Pass Watcher
Config.Description: Notify-only watcher.

Config.Name: AliExpress Email
Config.Description: AliExpress coins (deprecated).

Config.Name: AliExpress Active

Config.Name: Quality Filter
Config.Description: Skip low-quality games using Steam ratings.

Config.Name: Quality Skip Unmatched
Config.Description: Skip games not found on Steam.

Config.Name: Captcha Provider
Config.Description: Optional paid captcha solver.

Config.Name: VNC Password
Config.Description: Password for VNC. Also turns on panel auth if PANEL_PASSWORD is empty.

Config.Name: Panel Port
Config.Description: Internal panel port. Change together with the port mapping.

Config.Name: noVNC Port
Config.Description: Internal noVNC port. Host and container port must match.

Config.Name: Base Path
Config.Description: Subfolder for a reverse proxy, e.g. /fgc

Config.Name: noVNC URL
Config.Description: Separate noVNC URL when it is served on its own subdomain.

Config.Name: Update Check
Config.Description: 0 disables the 6-hourly GitHub update check.

Config.Name: Width
Config.Description: Virtual screen width.

Config.Name: Height
Config.Description: Virtual screen height.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Browser locale, e.g. de_DE.UTF-8.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Optional. Run as this user (e.g. 99) instead of root; /fgc/data is chowned on start.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Optional. Group for PUID (e.g. 100). Defaults to PUID.

Config.Name: Timeout (s)
Config.Description: Page timeout.

Config.Name: Login Timeout (s)
Config.Description: How long to wait for a login.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: Do everything except claiming.

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Set 1 for debug logging.
